observationSemantics.timebase: Source quarter-note beats; elapsed time only from a validated explicit complete native clock.
observationSemantics.attackGrouping: Sort by source onset then stable physical event ID. The earliest unused onset opens a group; include onsets no more than 1e-9 source quarter beats after that first onset, inclusive. Do not use transitive chaining. Partition by known declared hand; keep unknown-hand events separately visible. Exact rational times remain the reference.

numericTolerance.use: Floating representation error only; never a near-note matching or quantization permission.

observationSemantics.deterministicOrder: Chronological group order; within a group use MIDI pitch then stable physical event ID, with source-origin IDs sorted by ASCII code-point order. Input-array order never selects an anchor or a recurrence.
observationSemantics.halfOpenOccupation: A physical key event occupies [attack, attack+dur). Releases at the new attack are processed before that attack. Earlier events with release strictly after attack are carried.
observationSemantics.newAttackNotCarry: Events beginning in the current onset group are new attacks, not carried predecessors.
observationSemantics.registerComparison: Successive complete known-hand attack groups, with their complete attacked pitch ranges and each prior event release retained.
observationSemantics.registerAnchor: Highest attacked MIDI pitch in each compared group; signed next-minus-prior semitones. This is an explicit pitch anchor, not a hand center.
observationSemantics.registerReleaseAnchor: Latest physical key release among all physical events in the previous compared attack group; retain the individual releases as witnesses.
observationSemantics.registerReleaseGap: Next attack time minus that latest previous-group physical release, signed; a negative value records overlap.
observationSemantics.sameKeyRecurrence: Consecutive physical attacks for an explicitly known (hand, MIDI key) pair, independent of other-hand or other-key attacks; preserve incompatible multiplicity as ambiguous/invalid rather than choose by input order.
observationSemantics.compatibleUnison: One physical event may carry multiple compatible source origins. Count every origin occurrence separately; count one physical attack and never invent another reattack.
observationSemantics.ties: A tied note spanning a bar is one physical event. The declared notation segments do not create attacks or same-key recurrences at tie boundaries.
observationSemantics.unknownHands: Keep omitted source hands unknown. A known-hand carried list with relevant unassigned predecessors is unqualified, not a proven empty list. Output hand labels are separate arrangement assumptions.
observationSemantics.unknownClock: An undeclared/default tempo permits beat/order facts but native seconds and per-second observations stay unknown. A numeric 120 field alone gives no authority.
observationSemantics.invalidClock: Malformed explicit tempo metadata is invalid. Refuse it; do not silently sort away, filter, clamp, average, or replace it with a fallback.
observationSemantics.pedal: Physical key release is start+dur. Channel-scoped CC64 eligibility is a separate controller fact; no inference of finger occupation or measured acoustic decay.
observationSemantics.nativeIntegration: Integrate the piecewise native clock exactly once. If mapped to a constant C-quarter-BPM clock, v(b)=T(b)*C/60. Subsequent elapsed time uses that constant clock, without reintegrating source tempo events.
observationSemantics.playbackScenario: A speed multiplier s rescales elapsed time by 1/s and leaves source identity, pitches and source beats unchanged. It is not a new arrangement.

scenarios.authority: explicit hypothetical playback scenario; no generated tier output implied

identityPolicy.required: Every named required physical event and all its named source-origin occurrences retain their declared exact fields under the verified source-to-output clock transform.
identityPolicy.optional: Only named allowed transformations may affect the listed optional source identities. Optional material is not a desired-output oracle.
identityPolicy.unlistedGeneratedMaterial: May be retained only as explicitly observed generated material governed by unchanged generation and validation; it cannot satisfy a required source occurrence by substitution.
identityPolicy.restScope: All-role and selected bass-role rests include declared CC64 eligibility, consistent with maintained PhrasePlan semantics; no event may be moved into a required rest.

restIdBinding.sourceAndTierIds: authoredRestDeclarations[].id and tiers[].requiredRestIds[] are local to their enclosing caseId.
restIdBinding.exactRule: For case C and local rest ID R, the corresponding PhrasePlan rest ID is C + ":" + R. Match that exact ID and the same source-beat start, end, and scope.
restIdBinding.tierScope: The same mapping applies to every tier with a PhrasePlan. It does not assert a plan exists for a retained-refusal row with phrasePlanLocation=null.

identityPolicy.knownVersusUnknownHand: Known source hand is an exact source field. Unknown source hand has no factual L/R value to preserve; the maintained splitter can yield only a separately declared output assumption.
identityPolicy.sourceSelectionAuthority: Authored motif, left-anchor, release, rest and ending choices are authoritative only for these original control inputs. No automatic role-selection or real-song accuracy follows.

physicalArtifactPolicy.allSix: For each of the 11 source cases, retain one row for each of the six named physical tiers. Supply actual canonical notes plus actual MIDI and MusicXML bytes/hashes and reparses, or an explicit retained refusal reason.
physicalArtifactPolicy.baselineLabel: observed generation baseline after the independent freeze; not desired reference
physicalArtifactPolicy.exactCorrespondence: Bind canonical attacks to reparsed physical attacks by an explicit unambiguous exact structural correspondence under pinned clock, hand/channel, velocity and tie-normalization rules. Formats without source IDs cannot certify source IDs.
physicalArtifactPolicy.ambiguity: If exact descriptors admit multiple different correspondences, retain ambiguity/refusal. Repeated nearest-pitch or nearest-time guessing is prohibited.
physicalArtifactPolicy.unisonMapping: The named compatible unison is explicitly many-source-origins-to-one-physical-attack; all other named local core events expect one physical attack per event before any allowed omission.
physicalArtifactPolicy.tieMapping: The named barline tie expects one physical attack after valid tie-chain normalization, even if MusicXML serializes two tied segments.
physicalArtifactPolicy.retainedRefusals: Do not remove difficult sources, erase required origins, truncate protected releases or lower maintained gates to make six successes.
physicalArtifactPolicy.hashes: Retain source, reference, policy, exact plan-set/pointer and extracted plan hash, canonical inventory, MIDI and MusicXML bytes/hashes, reparses, implementation head/tree/options and clock/scenario bindings.

verificationObligations.beforeImplementation: A different reviewer independently checks literal declarations and interval arithmetic, then root freezes exact files. This author submits only a proposed freeze.
verificationObligations.preProductionRed: New report tests must fail before production implementation and check these independent source facts, including signed release gaps, boundaries, multiplicity and uncertainties.
verificationObligations.shuffle: Reorder source Notes and same-onset events without altering IDs or music; named reference observations must stay identical.
verificationObligations.workBounds: The implementation must declare and validate finite input, tempo-mapping and materialized-relation budgets before expensive allocation. Exercise both acceptance and refusal boundaries. This corpus does not change production admission limits.
verificationObligations.invalidInputs: Retain malformed-clock and conflicting-independent-key controls; add explicit malformed shape/nonfinite-number/workload tests as implementation contracts, without revising these source facts.
